questions.q: Chronic kidney disease in the CTID section is characterized by more than ______% interstitial fibrosis, tubular atrophy or glomerular sclerosis.
Fill up: Lithium causes microcystic changes in the ______ tubules without interstitial inflammation.
The toxin associated with saturnine gout and hyperuricaemia is:
Match the following — 1) first item 2) second item 3) third item … A) PCT to DCT B) Glomerulus to PCT C) Loop of Henle only
The typical proteinuria in chronic tubulointerstitial disease is:
questions.exp: Less than 2 g/day with β2-microglobulin. (Book p794)

questions.q: Fill up: The maximum anaemia among the listed CKD patterns is seen in ______.
Nephrogenic diabetes insipidus in CKD is linked to:
opts: Cortical collecting-duct fibrosis with reduced ADH action
questions.exp: Cortical collecting-duct fibrosis with reduced ADH action. (Book p794)

questions.q: CKDu is commonly reported on the:
Fill up: CKDu is often asymptomatic until ______.
Match the following — 1) first item 2) second item 3) third item … A) Interstitial fibrosis and tubular atrophy B) Crescentic GN and pulmonary haemorrhage C) Glomerular amyloid only
questions.exp: Interstitial fibrosis and tubular atrophy. (Book p795)
